svg.title: Corrida das Palavras
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Corrida das Palavras.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished premium pixel-art cover illustration for the educational adventure game VOICES, the challenge Corrida das Palavras. Wide landscape composition, aspect ratio 20:9, intended to fill a 640x288 game selection card. This is finished game key art, NOT a UI screenshot or a collage. Rich, meticulous handcrafted 16-bit pixel art with crisp small pixels, selective dithering, dimensional light and shadows, expressive readable silhouettes and layered detailed environments. A Black teenage girl with dark brown skin, short voluminous curly afro hair, a lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, dark navy trousers and white-soled sneakers runs away from camera along a sunlit three-lane cobblestone street. Three luminous wooden word gateways stand ahead across the three lanes; each contains a floating illustrated book or scroll, no lettering. Golden collectible coins lead toward a glowing central gateway; one low wooden obstacle occupies another lane. Charming Brazilian neighborhood buildings with tiled roofs, bookshop windows, lush trees and festive small pennants give the street warmth and cultural specificity, cozy school adventure rather than a generic fantasy war. Compose the running character prominently in the lower middle with the gateways as clear secondary focal points. Beautiful warm amber sunlight, teal and sage architecture, ochre gold highlights, cream and terracotta, purple clothing as an accent. Storytelling, energetic, polished indie game art, highly legible when reduced to a small thumbnail. Edge-to-edge scenery, no frame, no mockup, no title, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks, no logo, no HUD, no photorealism, no smooth vector shapes, no toy-like 3D. Keep all essential characters and gateways within the central 75 percent height so a panoramic card crop preserves the action."}
